name: order_flow_imbalance_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: When buy volume (volume on uptick bars) significantly exceeds sell volume (volume on downtick bars) over a 10-bar window, aggressive buyers are dominating. This volume delta predicts near-term price direction for 5-15 bars. The inefficiency exists because most retail platforms don't display volume delta, and computing it in real-time across multiple stocks requires infrastructure. Edge persists because volume delta captures hidden institutional intent before it manifests in price.

filters.time_filter: no trades first 10 min or last 15 min
filters.spread_filter: skip if spread > 0.06% (tight spreads required for scalps)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — volume delta is gaining popularity among Indian retail traders

weaknesses: Volume delta using close vs open is a crude proxy — true order flow needs tick data
Very tight target (20 bps) vs costs (12-15 bps) means net edge is thin
High frequency (up to 12 trades/day) amplifies brokerage costs significantly
prior_art: Volume delta / cumulative delta — order flow concept from futures trading (Dalton, Steidlmayer). Adapted for equities.
notes: If tick-level data becomes available, switch to true bid/ask volume delta for much better accuracy.
